description: Fork of exp216 (V2D linear, val_bpb=1.7407 @ 8K, 114M). Single change: V2D pair sampling mode 'uniform' -> 'doubling'. Each head's pair set now starts from a circular doubling-step graph (offsets {1,2,4,8,...,128} mod E=192, ~1488 unique edges per head; we have 1456 pairs so a random subset of doubling edges is taken). Guarantees full anchor coverage and small graph diameter (~log E) per head. Hypothesis: structured pair sampling reduces the variance of which pairs each head sees, giving the LUT-V2D pipeline a more uniform 'distance-spectrum' to learn from.
